findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 列出全球與中國區域競爭者（Komatsu、Sany、XCMG、LiuGong、SDLG、Shantui 等），並稱競爭強度有時造成特定產業或地區價格折扣、壓縮利潤。
findings.excerpt: Our global surface competitors include Deere Construction & Forestry (part of Deere & Company), Epiroc AB, Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd., Komatsu Ltd., Liebherr-International AG, Sandvik AB, and Volvo Construction Equipment.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：競爭者積極定價等可能降低公司產業銷售份額。
findings.excerpt: Thus, our share of industry sales could be reduced due to aggressive pricing or product strategies pursued by competitors, unanticipated product or manufacturing difficulties, our failure to price our products competitively
